---
title: Track Points
description: >-
  View customer point balances, and transaction histories showing when and where
  points were added or deducted.
---
<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="1376" height="760" style="width: 1376px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />

Step

1. Navigate to Incentives > Points > Points Lists.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="374" height="193" style="width: 374px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />

2. Click and view customer’s details.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="575" height="258" style="width: 575px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />

3. View every instance where points were added or deducted, including the specific reason, the location, and the exact date and time.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="484" height="277" style="width: 484px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />
